subject: Helix Therapeutics — PO & invoice field requirements / cadence
messages:
From: Sophie Lamel <sophie.lamel@helixthera.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@helixthera.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PO requirements and invoice cadence for Redwood subscription

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement has asked me to send over the specific PO/invoice requirements so we can get finance to issue a master PO. Important points from our side:

- PO number must appear on every invoice and in the invoice filename (system requirement).
- Invoices must include Helix GL & cost center codes in a dedicated line item (we will provide mapping).
- We require monthly invoices per SKU (usage/seat line items split by month); we cannot accept consolidated quarterly invoices.
- Net 45 payment terms (we are legal/finance conservative right now).
- We need SOC-2 attestation and insurance certificate attached to the vendor record.
- Preferred payment method is ACH; our team will provide banking template after vendor setup.

I've attached our standard PO template to this message (Helix_PO_Template.pdf). Also include me in the loop on any contract amendments — procurement needs the invoice sample to get vendor onboarding approved.

Can you confirm Redwood can deliver monthly, PO-numbered invoices and include a column for GL code? If there are any pricing/packaging implications on your side (e.g., discount tiers that require annual billing), please flag them so we can present to our CFO.

Best,
Sophie Lamel
Head of Procurement — Helix Therapeutics
Sophie.Lamel@helixthera.com

Attachments: Helix_PO_Template.pdf

From: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
To: Sophie Lamel <sophie.lamel@helixthera.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence for Redwood subscription

Sophie —

Thanks for the detailed note and the template. Short answers up front: yes, we can put the PO number on every invoice and include a GL/cost-center column. We can also produce monthly line-item invoices (one invoice per calendar month).

A couple of points to flag so we have alignment before procurement finalizes the PO:

- Pricing/discounting: The most common way we deliver the 10–20% pricing tiers is via annual commitments (prepaid or invoiced annually). If Helix needs Net 45 and monthly invoices, we can support that, but discounts tied to an annual commit will need a separate purchase-class SKU or an addendum.
- Invoice filename: we will generate invoices with the PO number in the filename automatically if you provide the exact PO format (the template helps).
- SOC2/Insurance: we will upload SOC2 letter and cert to your vendor portal; attached is our SOC2 letter for now (helix_soc2_letter.pdf).
- Logistics: To make accounting reconciliation simpler, I suggest we produce an "invoice manifest" (CSV) with line-level fields you mentioned (date range, SKU, quantity, unit price, GL code column). We can share the manifest as part of the invoice bundle.

Looping in Vivek (finance) for payment-term and discount detail, and Laura (CS ops) for invoice manifest formatting. If you prefer, we can provide a sample invoice (redwood_invoice_template.xlsx) populated with a mock PO number.

Next step: Sophie, can you confirm whether the discount eligibility is required to appear on the PO (i.e., an explicit annual commitment) or if Helix prefers us to provide an addendum after vendor setup?

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood_invoice_template.xlsx, helix_soc2_letter.pdf

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, michael_grant@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence for Redwood subscription

Team —

Quick internal note on payment/discounts:

- We can accept Net 45 as a commercial term for Enterprise customers in the US. Finance preference is to avoid Net 60/90 without credit checks.
- If Helix wants a 12–15% discount we tie that to a 12-month committed ARR SKU; discount is applied pro rata monthly on invoices but requires contract/PO language that guarantees the term length.
- For monthly invoicing + annual commitment, we can issue monthly invoices and carry a field that references the annual commitment ID; we do not require a single annual prepay unless they want a deeper multi-year discount.
- GL code and extra vendor fields are straightforward; Laura, please prepare the invoice manifest template matching Helix's PO columns.

Happy to approve Net 45 for this deal pending confirmation that the PO will include the commitment term for any volume discounts.

-Vivek
VP, Finance — Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@helixthera.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Sophie Lamel <sophie.lamel@helixthera.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 08:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence for Redwood subscription

Jonas / Vivek —

Thanks for the quick responses. A few clarifications from Finance:

- Helix can accept an annual commitment referenced on the PO (e.g., "12-month commitment: HLX-2026-RED-01") while receiving monthly invoices reflecting usage/seat counts. That solves our internal budget planning.
- For discounting: our CFO will only approve a baseline 12% off list for a 12-month commitment. Anything deeper needs an executive exception. Please include the discount percentage and commitment term on the PO so our AP system can route approval properly.
- Net 45 is acceptable. We will provide banking details after vendor setup.
- For the invoice filename requirement, we will send the exact regex our system expects (filename must start with the PO number followed by YYYYMM).

Sophie will follow up with the exact PO number format and the GL code mapping this afternoon.

Regards,
Daniel Cho
Finance — Helix Therapeutics

Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence for Redwood subscription

Sophie / Daniel —

Great, thanks for confirming the approach. Action items from Redwood:

1) I will send a populated sample invoice (with mock PO HLX-2026-RED-01 and the filename pattern you provide) by EOD tomorrow so procurement can validate the filename and GL column. Attachment: redwood_invoice_template.xlsx (sample).
2) Laura will publish the invoice manifest template to your shared drive (CSV) with columns: invoice_number, invoice_date, PO_number, SKU, qty, unit_price, line_total, GL_code, cost_center.
3) Vivek will confirm discount language for the 12% 12-month commitment and provide suggested PO wording (we recommend: "12-month commitment; discount 12% applied to listed unit prices; monthly invoicing per usage; PO references contract ID HLX-ENT-2026-04").
4) Michael (legal) will prepare a short addendum if Helix requires discount to be explicitly embedded into the PO vs. separate contract.

Sophie — could you please share the filename regex and the GL mapping file when available? Once we have that, we'll get the vendor setup packet ready.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting this live.

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood_invoice_template.xlsx
